newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr strengthens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr strengthens against dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr strengthened marginally against the dollar on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia said.
It quoted the birr at a mean rate of 6.41 against the dollar on Monday compared to 6.42 last week.
The bank said following a currency auction held on November 16, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the November 18-24 period would be 6.41 to the dollar.
